//: npm run check:types. checkJs is OFF: a js/ file enters the checked population by carrying `// @ts-check` at the top, and nothing else lists it. include only makes every js/ file VISIBLE to the checker (imports resolve, types flow); an unchecked file reports nothing. strict is off because the first population was chosen by where the contract lives, not by how clean it already was — see DECISIONS.md «型検査は段階的に». types/ holds the declared contracts.
